verdict.rationale: Shopify runs a live discovery index, the Global Catalog MCP server, that lets agents search hundreds of millions of listings across merchants. Runtime probes confirmed it is live and gated by agent profile, and each storefront publishes a /.well-known/ucp profile describing its services, capabilities and payment handlers. However, the index covers products from Shopify merchants, not a general directory of payable services or APIs, and merchant endpoints are found through product offers or known shop origins rather than a listed registry. Missing for 10: a published directory or index of payable services/APIs (not just products), an enumerable registry of UCP-enabled merchant endpoints, independent hands-on corroboration of service-level discovery.
